task_completion.description: The agent successfully launched CoppeliaSim and is logged into the 'ga' account.
task_completion.visual_evidence: CoppeliaSim application window is visible; terminal or file explorer shows the user is 'ga'.

task_completion.description: Programmatically constructed a 4-step gauge block of adjoining cuboids in the scene.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D scene view shows four distinct cuboids of increasing heights (0.02m to 0.08m) arranged in a row along the X-axis.

task_completion.description: A proximity sensor is attached to the robot's end-effector pointing downwards.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The robot model in the scene shows a proximity sensor object (often a red line or cone) attached to the tool flange, oriented towards the floor/blocks.

task_completion.description: The robot performs a linear sweep over the gauge block to collect data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the robot end-effector moving linearly across the top of the four steps while the simulation is running.

task_completion.description: Exported scan_data.csv with at least 40 rows of data including surface_z calculations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal 'cat' command shows scan_data.csv in /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/ with columns for timestamp, ee_x, ee_y, ee_z, sensor_dist, and surface_z.

task_completion.description: Exported calibration_metrics.json and saved the scene as calibration_setup.ttt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/ directory contains both calibration_metrics.json and calibration_setup.ttt.

integrity.description: The agent actually ran the simulation rather than just creating static files.
integrity.visual_evidence: The simulation play button in CoppeliaSim is active (pressed) and the simulation time counter is non-zero during the sweep.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually type out the CSV/JSON content in a text editor without running the robot.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen writing and executing Python/ZMQ code to control the simulation, rather than just using 'echo' or a text editor to create the final reports.

integrity.description: The data in the exported files matches the physical dimensions of the blocks in the scene.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'surface_z' values in the CSV or 'max_surface_z_m' in the JSON correspond to the 0.08m height of the tallest block.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The gauge block must have 4 steps with heights 0.02, 0.04, 0.06, and 0.08 meters. The scan_data.csv must contain at least 40 rows. The surface_z is calculated as ee_z minus sensor_dist. All outputs must be located in /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/.
